{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Web plugin: choose model and reasoning effort, then execute, compact-and-execute, or start fresh with a reviewed plan.","id":"gh:1432184967","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-great-plan","slug":"onefl666/dsh-great-plan","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Web plugin: choose model and reasoning effort, then execute, compact-and-execute, or start fresh"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" with a reviewed plan."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Great Plan"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DSH Web plugin: choose the model and reasoning effort, then execute a reviewed plan in place, afte"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"r compaction, or in a fresh session."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Execute plan** — approve the plan and continue in the current session with the selected model.
-"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" **Compact and execute** — compact the history before the plan, then approve it in place.
- **Start "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"fresh and execute…** — stop the current turn and run the plan as the first message of a new session "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"in the same workspace, with a selectable agent preset. The message also carries the instructions the"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" user sent during the current plan-mode session, in chronological order, and ends with the canonical"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" native approval handoff: `Plan approved — plan mode exited; carry out the plan starting with your n"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ext step.` The old session is kept.
- **Fresh-session context in Minimal mode** — when the new sessi"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"on uses the built-in **Minimal mode** preset, the first message also carries the workspace directory"},{"id":"p6s9","text":", system platform, current time/time zone, and a note that the previous context was cleared. This co"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"mpensates for the Minimal preset's suppressed runtime context. Turn this off on the plugin's Setting"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"s page.
- **Brainstorming-guided plans** — the planner acts as Team Lead: `spawn_teammate` creates a"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"t least two parallel exploration teammates with distinct concrete scopes, plus one separate planning"},{"id":"p6s13","text":" teammate that drafts the candidate final plan; the planner verifies the evidence itself, asks one s"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"hort question at a time only when ambiguity could change the approach, and summarizes key rationale,"},{"id":"p6s15","text":" tradeoffs, and assumptions (advisory only). Turn this off on the plugin's Settings page; the eviden"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"ce and handoff guidance stays.
- **Unlimited-token-budget plans** — in plan mode and fresh-session e"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"xecution, remind the model that its token budget is unlimited and not to cut investigation, tool cal"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"ls, or necessary questions to save tokens (advisory only). Turn this off on the plugin's Settings pa"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"sary questions to save tokens (advisory only). Turn this off on the plugin's Settings page.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DSH with the Web client, version 0.2.1-rc.3 or newer (verified on 0.2.1-rc.5).
- **Compact and exe"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"cute** needs a compaction backend in the DSH composition. Without one, the dialog shows the failure "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"and lets you retry, execute the plan anyway, or cancel."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"npm package name: `@onefl666/dsh-great-plan`. Install the published package with `plugin_manager` `i"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"nstall_bundle`, using the package spec as the target (for example `@onefl666/dsh-great-plan@0.5.0`)."},{"id":"p10s3","text":" For a local checkout, use the absolute package directory as the target instead. The plugin then app"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ears in the Plugins list as **Great Plan**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"1. Enter plan mode with `/plan` and ask the agent for a plan.
2. When the review card appears, click"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" **Execution options**.
3. Optionally pick a model and reasoning effort. The change applies to the s"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ession immediately and matches the Composer model selector.
4. Pick an execution method:
- **Execute"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" plan** — approves the plan.
- **Compact and execute** — compacts first. If compaction is unavailabl"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"e, empty, fails, or is cancelled, the plan is not approved: choose **Retry compaction**, **Execute a"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"nyway**, or **Cancel**. Closing the dialog while it runs cancels the wait.
- **Start fresh and execu"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"te…** — review the first-message preview and this-run switches, choose an agent preset, then confirm"},{"id":"p12s8","text":". The new session opens with the approved plan (plus the instructions and, for Minimal mode, the run"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"time context you kept enabled) and the canonical approval handoff at the end; the old session is sto"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"pped after the new message is sent and is kept.
5. **Back to editing** hides the review card and ret"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"urns to the composer for change requests, exactly like the native Discuss action; **Execute plan** i"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"s the native Approve."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Command"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`/great-plan-compact` compacts the history before the pending plan. **Compact and execute** calls it"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" for you; it also appears in the command menu and takes no arguments."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The model list now has a simple substring search; the Composer model control remains the full pick"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"er, and the two never share state.
- Selecting a model is also saved as the default model (existing "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"DSH behavior).
- Compaction makes one summary model request.
- The new-session title prefix and stop"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ping the old session are best-effort.
- The native **Approve** / **Request changes** buttons sit beh"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ind the dialog while it is open. Close the dialog (or use **Back to editing**, which equals Request "},{"id":"p18s6","text":"changes) before using them; **Execute plan** is the in-dialog Approve.
- The conversation's command "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"result cards stay English even in a Chinese UI (the Host command contract has no locale); the dialog"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"'s compaction failure text is localized.
- The budget, brainstorming, and evidence guidance is advis"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ory; the plugin does not validate model compliance or verify that teammates were actually spawned. C"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ommand descriptions are not localized. The Settings switches need the DSH settings services; without"},{"id":"p18s11","text":" them the page is not registered and all four switches default to on.
- The unlimited-budget reminde"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"r is added only to the plan-mode prompt and the **Start fresh and execute…** first message; **Compac"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"t and execute** does not add it. The Client reads the fresh-session switches from the configuration "},{"id":"p18s14","text":"mirror and defaults to on when the settings UI is unavailable.
- The canonical approval handoff (`Pl"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"an approved — plan mode exited; carry out the plan starting with your next step.`) is always appende"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"d at the end of the fresh-session first message, is intentionally English, and is not controlled by "},{"id":"p18s17","text":"the three this-run switches. **Compact and execute** does not add a second copy: the native approval"},{"id":"p18s18","text":" result already carries it. The clear-view preview counts it in the total size.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"There is no build step or installed dependency. The Host half imports a few DSH packages (`@deepseek"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"-ai/schemastery`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction`) that the running installation supplies, declared as"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" peer dependencies.
